title: The Complete set of tools
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：complete　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 complete 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 the porter wrote of ① a complete set of tools in the journal, and everybody in the coast said at once that it was ② more complete than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the porter, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the complete ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most complete set of tools anybody in the coast had ever seen, or so the journal for August 1945 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too complete to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the visitor who had come to help; the complete ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a complete silence in the hall, and said that no visitor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as complete as the silence in the hall they had once had in the old coast. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was complete or not, and he said so.

By 1958 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was ⑦ something complete, and nothing besides. The visitor from the next coast called the whole plan ⑧ quite complete; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the journal kept the names of the complete ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1961, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another complete set of tools in the same journal, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more complete than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most complete silence in the hall in the whole coast, she said in 1963, was the one she could never quite name; the complete ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 完整（前置定语 a complete set of tools：1951 年挑夫在行记里记下的那件完整的一整套工具）
B. adj. 完整／彻底（比较级 more complete than：文中两处，一处比一整套工具，一处比预想）
C. adj. 完整／彻底（最高级 the most complete：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 完整（表语 too complete to do：母亲觉得它太完整，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 彻底（前置定语 a complete silence in the hall：叔叔把整件事称作一桩彻底的死寂）
F. adj. 彻底（同级比较 as complete as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩厅里的死寂相比）
G. adj. 彻底（后置定语 something complete：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 彻底（受程度副词修饰 quite complete：那位游客的评价）

items.q: the most complete set of tools anybody
a complete silence in the hall
The most complete silence in the hall in

answers.why: complete 意为“完整”，1951 年挑夫在行记里记下的是“一件完整的一整套工具”，此处作前置定语 a complete set of tools。
complete 意为“完整”，此处用比较级 more complete than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
complete 意为“完整”，行记上 八月 那行字说它是海岸里最完整的一件，故用最高级 the most complete set of tools。
complete 意为“完整”，母亲认为这件东西“太完整了，谁也用不上”，too complete to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
complete 意为“彻底”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩彻底的死寂”，此处作前置定语 a complete silence in the hall。
complete 意为“彻底”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩厅里的死寂一样彻底”，同级比较用 as complete as。
complete 意为“彻底”，行记上那半行字要的是“彻底的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something complete。
complete 意为“彻底”，邻海岸来的那位游客认为这套计划“相当彻底”，quite 修饰原级 complete。
complete 意为“彻底”，1961 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要彻底”，故用比较级 more complete than。
complete 意为“彻底”，母亲 1963 年说的是“整个海岸里最彻底的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most complete silence in the hall。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1951 年，挑夫在行记里记下了一件完整的一整套工具。（a complete set of tools）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更完整。（more complete than …）
母亲觉得它太完整，谁也用不上。（too complete to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩彻底的死寂。（a complete silence in the hall）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩厅里的死寂一样彻底。（as complete as …）
到了 1958 年，行记上只剩半行字：要的是一件彻底的东西。（something complete）
answers: In 1951 the porter wrote of a complete set of tools in the journal.
Everybody said it was more complete than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too complete to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a complete silence in the hall.
He said nobody would call it as complete as the silence in the hall they had once had.
By 1958 the journal asked for nothing but something complete.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 complete 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1951 the porter wrote of a complete set of tools in the journal, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most complete set of tools in the coast, or so the journal says.
My mother thought it too complete to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a complete silence in the hall, and nobody argued with him.
The visitor from the next coast called the plan quite complete, and everybody laughed.
The complete ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
